notes: Models A and B each completed two Kaggle folds x three epochs, with SHA-verified checkpoints. On adjacent-frame pair metrics, B improved on A but showed mixed results versus saved exp016 control: pair precision and false positives worsened on both embryos. Official graph score remains unmeasured; no adoption or completion decision has been made.

limitations: Only one seed per fold; no causal ablation of identity initialization, epoch budget, or spatial attention.
Validation selection maximizes edge_accuracy times fixed candidate_node_recall, equivalent to minimizing FP plus FN on the fixed pair mask; division recovery is not included.
Sparse-teacher unknown-endpoint fractions describe the masks, not a measured label-error rate.
Official graph score is not measured for A/B.
